title: Project Lighthouse 001 Minimum Vertical Slice
purpose: Demonstrate immediate end-to-end engineering value on a reference building while AIAS continues maturing toward organizational Level 5.
scope: Reference brief, assumptions, conceptual model, foundation chain, calculations, drawings, quantities, descriptive report, golden-thread traceability and review-controlled technical dossier.

requirements.title: Project brief
requirements.statement: The slice shall define project purpose, scope, assumptions, units and professional boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Real engine consumption
requirements.statement: The slice shall consume the validated ECP foundation calculation, checking, documentation, delivery and handover chain.
requirements.rationale: Ensure infrastructure has an immediate engineering consumer.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Technical deliverables
requirements.statement: The slice shall produce calculations, vector drawings, quantities, descriptive report and technical dossier evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Golden thread
requirements.statement: Every delivered artifact shall link need, requirement, assumption, knowledge, calculation, result, drawing, document and review state.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Maturity and legal status
requirements.statement: The slice shall distinguish reference capability from construction approval and require professional review.
requirements.rationale: Prevent unsafe use and unsupported maturity claims.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible release
requirements.statement: The slice shall provide tests, CLI, documentation, installer, manifest, checksums and versioned release.
requirements.rationale: Make the project a permanent regression consumer.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
